text:
emma: Quick sync thread for regional GTM choreography. We need to lock: blog embargo timing, per-region landing pages, partner badge distribution, SI standby windows, and the go/no-go checklist. Who can take owners?
rob: I can take the blog + press kit. Draft ready for review tomorrow. Question: single global embargo or staggered regional lifts?
iyad: Engineering prefers staggered (NA -> EU -> APAC) to smooth traffic. Suggest 20m gaps. Ops can automate via feature-flag rollout.
claire: Marketing + Legal preference is single global embargo to avoid leak risk. If we must stagger, partners need clear guidance about what they can publish and when.
partners-bot: Note: embargo options saved to /playbooks/embargo-options.md. Calendar placeholders created for both scenarios.
emma: Tradeoffs noted. Proposal: stagger flips but keep a global embargo end-time for coordinated announcements (partners can do region-specific comms after their region is live but must respect global PR embargo until 12:00 PT). Agree?
alec: Sounds reasonable. Also need to confirm badge asset version (v3) and whether partners can co-brand quickstart PDFs. Nvidia partner already asked for co-branding approval.
iyad: Tech checklist: 1) create region-specific CDN purges 2) pre-warm caches 3) feature-flag rollout IDs: ff.market.na, ff.market.eu, ff.market.apac 4) smoke tests for telemetry. I'll put these in the runbook.
rob: Blog timeline: draft by Tue 09:00 PT, legal review by Tue 17:00 PT, final sign-off Wed 10:00 PT. Press embargo nominally Wed 11:00 PT in this plan.
claire: Legal requests: no absolute uptime claims, localized privacy/link for EU/JP, and partner trademark approvals for any logos. Need badge usage docs by Tue COB.
partners-bot: Asset upload reminder: /assets/partners/badges-v3.zip. Checksum: d41d8cd9. Trademark approvals pending: list attached in /legal/partner-approvals.csv.
emma: SI standby: propose rota 07:30-15:30 PT (two shifts) on launch day with one vendor SME on call. Partners have asked for a 45m dry-run 48 hours prior. Can SI reps confirm availability?
ialec: Partner SME confirmed for 07:30-15:30. Dry-run OK on Mon 14:00 PT. Alec will own the SI runbook checklist.
iyad: I'll add automated rollback triggers in runbook: if error-rate > 2% sustained for 5m OR median tail latency > 3x baseline for 10m -> auto rollback. Also keep old catalog route for 20m after flip.
rob: PR helpline: who staffs first two hours? Marketing or Partnerships?
claire: PR will staff media inquiries; Partnerships to triage partner technical questions. I will publish a helpline rota 07:30-11:30 PT.
emma: Draft runbook snippet (v0.1) below, please flag gaps:
```
Runbook snippet - v0.1
- T-60m: pre-cutover health checks (CDN, auth, billing, partner assets render)
- T-20m NA: pre-warm edge caches, validate tracking events
- T=0 NA: flip ff.market.na -> verify smoke events
- T+20m EU: flip ff.market.eu -> verify smoke events
- T+40m APAC: flip ff.market.apac -> verify smoke events
- T+60m: aggregated telemetry review -> lift final embargo at 12:00 PT
- Rollback: auto or manual if triggers hit. Contacts: ops@, partners@, pr-oncall
```
claire: Add one-pager with key messages and embargo FAQ to the runbook for spokes. I'll draft that. Also will prep a legal-safe boilerplate for partners to use.
partners-bot: Reminder: staging tokens expire 2026-03-24T23:59Z. Use /token rotate to request new ones for dry-runs.
alec: For hardware partners: if we list GPU SKUs, we must include clear licensing and SKU mapping (hosted vs dedicated vs private). Will need that table in blog appendix.
iyad: Noted. Dev will produce SKU mapping and sample pricing references. Add to the content repo by Wed AM.
emma: Localization: need EN/FR/DE/JP landing snippets by Wed EOD; APAC partners asked for EN/JP earlier if possible. Any volunteers for translations?
rob: Marketing will coordinate vendor translations; will push keys Tue morning. Please add string IDs to the content repo.
claire: Legal: send partner logo approvals and trademark documents to me by Tue 15:00 PT or we delay partner-specific tiles.
emma: Action recap: rob -> blog + press kit; claire -> legal boilerplate + spokes one-pager; iyad -> runbook + rollback config + SKU map; alec -> SI runbook + dry-run; partners-bot -> asset + token reminders. Meeting for go/no-go Thu 08:00 PT. If all lanes green, proceed Friday flip.
iyad: I will post the runbook v0.2 by Wed 09:00 PT with grafana panel links and feature-flag IDs.
rob: Ill drop the draft blog to /content/drafts/marketplace-launch.md by Tue 09:00 PT. Please review inline and leave :eyes: reactions.
claire: Legal will try to finish approvals by Wed 18:00 PT. If partners miss logo approvals, we stage generic partner text.
emma: Good. One more: partners asked for a co-branded quickstart PDF in the asset bundle. Can marketing add that to the badge package?
rob: Yes  will add co-branded quickstart to /assets/partners by Wed noon. Need logo files and usage approvals.
partners-bot: Calendar invites: dry-run Mon 14:00 PT, rehearsal Wed 10:00 PT, go/no-go Thu 08:00 PT. All posted.
emma: Thanks everyone. Keep updates here. If anything escalates, ping @emma and Ill loop product ops. If no major blockers by Wed EOD, consider this lane amber->green. :white_check_mark:
